diagnostics.message: capabilities of this Pack declare 2 different guard chains: "auth:conformanceAuthGuard, business:conformanceBusinessGuard" (conformance.terminal.chain-b); "business:conformanceBusinessGuard" (conformance.terminal.chain-a). types.ts fixes the chain as the owning Pack's FULL stateGuards/authGuards/business list in bundle order — pack-wide by construction, never a per-kind subset — so a divergent chain describes a set of reachable terminals the kernel will not produce.
